posts.title: Trying Out a Markdown Editor in WordPress
posts.description: Markdown I’ve been exploring writing with Markdown. Use it in Standard Notes, have used it in Obsidian. Trying out Zettlr and now this editor, View Markdown, a WordPress plugin. I like it. A simple editor with optional preview. Several ways to save. I’m figuring out if it can be one of my several Markdown editors. ... Read more

posts.title: Co-Op Rideshare
posts.description: Drivers Coop is a ridesharing cooperative in New York City. This is a great idea. It strikes back at Big Co, who are rapacious, completely enshittified, and worth striking. Buffalo could use this. I’m going to ask around, see if anyone has worked on this or is considering it.
